spans.s:
The द्वन्द and तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the words रात्र and अह्न are spoken of in masculine.

Terms: समास-gender

The affix ङीप् comes after the word रात्रि in the छन्दस् (Vedas) and in denoting a Name except the affix जस् (1st - Nominative Case Plural) is added.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्
The affix ख optionally in the senses taught in तेन निर्वृत्तम्

, after the words 1. रात्री 2. अहन् and 3. सम्वत्सर , occasioning a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound).

Terms: ख

The word रात्रि optionally takes मुम् augment before a word formed by कृत् affix.

Terms: मुम् Augment

Of a word ending in a conjunct consonant, only स् is elided if it comes after र् (but any other consonant coming after र् is not elided).

Terms: स् changed to ल्
